title: Real account: edit your own event
steps: On a real connected calendar create a test event with one guest you control
Change its title and time, choose Send to guests, wait for the Undo window to end
Check Google Calendar and the guest's inbox; then delete the event from Mail
Open an event someone else organizes and confirm its fields are read-only
expected: The title and time change in Google Calendar, the guest gets one update email, and Delete asks first. Someone else's event cannot be edited and offers Decline.
